Built on .NET 10 / Blazor Server with a local SQLite database.

title: Portabase
description: Portabase is a self-hosted dashboard to schedule, run and restore database backups for PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, MsSQL, Firebird, SQLite, MongoDB, Redis and Docker volumes. It supports retention policies, notifications and multiple storage backends (local, S3, Azure, GCS).

title: Super Productivity
description: Super Productivity is a privacy-focused, open-source to-do list, task manager and time tracker that helps you organize tasks, plan your day and track time. This deploys the self-hostable web (PWA) build as static files served by nginx.

title: AudioMuse-AI
description: AudioMuse-AI is a self-hosted tool that uses sonic analysis to rediscover forgotten songs and generate groove-aware playlists for your music library, without external APIs. It integrates with Jellyfin, Navidrome, Emby, Lyrion or Plex and runs a Flask web UI backed by Redis Queue workers and PostgreSQL.

title: Ignis
description: Ignis runs Obsidian in the browser by reimplementing the Electron APIs Obsidian uses, keeping your vaults on the server. It supports multiple vaults, plugins, file upload/download and sync across browser tabs, so you can access your Obsidian vault from any device without a desktop client.

title: Securo
description: Securo is a self-hosted personal finance manager for tracking accounts, transactions, budgets and assets. It ships a FastAPI backend with PostgreSQL and Celery, a React frontend, optional bank synchronization (Pluggy, Enable Banking, SimpleFIN), OIDC login and optional AI agents. All data stays on your own infrastructure.

title: Hammer
description: This installs the self-hosted sync server for Hammer, the offline-first story/novel writing app. The Kotlin/Ktor server lets you sync your Hammer projects across your own devices instead of using Dropbox or a third-party service. It ships with an in-process (embedded) PostgreSQL, so no external database is required. The server has no UI of its own - install the Hammer desktop/mobile client separately and point it at this server.

title: CentOS Stream
description: CentOS Stream is a continuously delivered Linux distribution that tracks just ahead of RHEL development.

title: Gentoo
description: Gentoo is a highly customizable source-based Linux distribution.

title: Devuan
description: Devuan is a Debian-derived Linux distribution that offers init-system freedom without systemd.

title: openEuler
description: openEuler is an open-source Linux distribution designed for servers and cloud computing.

title: openSUSE
description: openSUSE is a stable, easy-to-use Linux distribution with the YaST configuration tool and zypper package manager.

title: Arch Linux
description: Arch Linux is a lightweight, rolling-release Linux distribution that follows a keep-it-simple philosophy. It provides a minimalist base system that users can build upon according to their needs.

title: Fedora
description: Fedora is a cutting-edge Linux distribution sponsored by Red Hat, featuring current open-source technologies.

title: Portainer
description: Portainer Community Edition is a lightweight service delivery platform for containerized applications that can be used to manage Docker, Swarm, Kubernetes and ACI environments. It is designed to be as simple to deploy as it is to use. The application allows you to manage all your orchestrator resources (containers, images, volumes, networks and more) through a ‘smart’ GUI and/or an extensive API.

title: Decypharr
description: Decypharr exposes a mock qBittorrent and SABnzbd API in front of debrid services, so Sonarr, Radarr, Lidarr and friends can send downloads to Real-Debrid, Torbox, AllDebrid, Debrid-Link or Premiumize as if they were talking to a normal download client. It also supports direct Usenet streaming via NNTP without a separate download client.

title: Defguard
description: Defguard is a WireGuard VPN server combined with an identity provider. It adds user enrollment, multi-factor authentication, OpenID Connect SSO and per-user access control on top of WireGuard, all managed from a web interface. This installs the Defguard Core service; gateways are deployed separately on the machines that terminate the VPN tunnels.

title: Home Assistant Matter Hub
description: Home Assistant Matter Hub publishes your Home Assistant entities as Matter devices, so Apple Home, Google Home, Amazon Alexa and any other Matter controller can see and control them. It acts as a Matter bridge in front of Home Assistant and needs only a long-lived access token to connect. This installs the actively maintained RiDDiX fork - the original t0bst4r project reached end of maintenance in January 2026.

title: nebula-sync
description: nebula-sync keeps multiple Pi-hole v6 instances in sync by replicating the configuration of a primary Pi-hole to one or more replicas over the Pi-hole API. It can run a full Teleporter import/export or sync only selected features, on a cron schedule.

title: Stalwart
description: Stalwart is an all-in-one mail and collaboration server written in Rust. A single binary provides SMTP, IMAP, POP3, JMAP, CalDAV, CardDAV and WebDAV plus spam filtering, DKIM/SPF/DMARC and a web admin interface, with no external database required for a default install.

title: Stash
description: Stash is a self-hosted organizer for adult media collections. It scans your library, then enriches it with performers, studios, tags and scene metadata pulled from stash-box instances such as StashDB and from community scrapers, and serves everything through a web interface.

title: GitLab
description: GitLab CE is a complete DevOps platform: Git repository hosting, issue tracking, merge requests, CI/CD pipelines, a container registry and a package registry in one application. This installs the official Omnibus package, which bundles its own PostgreSQL, Redis, NGINX and Puma.

title: pyLoad
description: pyLoad is a lightweight download manager written in Python. It handles one-click hosters, container files (DLC, RSDF, CCF) and direct links, supports premium accounts, captcha solving and a plugin system, and is controlled through a web interface, a CLI or third-party clients.

title: Journiv
description: Journiv is a self-hosted, privacy-focused journaling app. It stores entries, photos and videos on your own server, supports activity and mood tracking, full-text search and imports from Daylio and other journaling apps, with a Flutter web frontend served by a FastAPI backend.

title: PeerTube
description: PeerTube is a federated, self-hosted video platform. Videos are distributed peer-to-peer via WebTorrent to reduce bandwidth on the origin server, and instances federate over ActivityPub so users can follow channels across the fediverse, including Mastodon.

title: TeslaMate
description: TeslaMate is a self-hosted data logger for Tesla vehicles. It records drives, charges, battery health, efficiency and vehicle updates into PostgreSQL and visualizes everything through a set of prebuilt Grafana dashboards, with optional MQTT publishing for home automation.

title: Your Spotify
description: Your Spotify records your Spotify listening history and turns it into statistics: top tracks, artists and albums over any period, listening habits by time of day, and long-term trends. Past history can be imported from a Spotify privacy data export.

title: Fleet
description: Fleet is an open-source device management platform for IT and security teams to manage and monitor servers, laptops, and other devices with osquery.

title: qBit Manage
description: qBit Manage keeps a qBittorrent instance tidy: tagging by tracker, cross-seed handling, orphaned file cleanup, share-limit enforcement, recheck of paused torrents and automatic removal of unregistered ones. It runs on a schedule and ships a web UI to configure the rules and inspect runs.

title: RustFS
description: RustFS is an S3-compatible object storage server written in Rust. It covers the S3 core API, versioning, bucket replication, lifecycle management, bitrot protection and multi-tenancy, and is a drop-in target for anything that speaks S3 - backup tools, media apps or CI artifacts. Frequently named as a MinIO alternative.

title: HAProxy
description: HAProxy is a TCP and HTTP load balancer and reverse proxy, known for handling very high connection counts with low latency. Unlike the UI-driven proxies it is configured entirely through a single text file, which makes it a good fit for layer-4 balancing, health checking and failover setups where a GUI proxy is not enough.

title: ntopng
description: ntopng is a network traffic probe and analyser. It shows who is talking to whom, which protocols and applications are in use, and keeps historical traffic statistics, with alerting and flow export on top. This installs the free Community Edition from the official ntop repository.

title: OwnTracks Recorder
description: OwnTracks Recorder stores and serves the location data published by the OwnTracks apps for iOS and Android. It subscribes to an MQTT broker, keeps the history in a local LMDB store, and provides a web interface plus an HTTP API for maps, tracks and friend positions - a self-hosted alternative to commercial location sharing.

title: Unsloth
description: Unsloth Studio is a local web UI for running and fine-tuning language models. It downloads and serves GGUF, LoRA and safetensors models, compares models side by side, and exposes OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoints for tools like Claude Code and Codex.

title: Yopass
description: Yopass shares secrets through one-time links. The secret is encrypted in the browser before it is sent, so the server only ever stores an opaque blob with an expiry, and the decryption key travels in the URL fragment which is never transmitted. Opening the link destroys the secret.

title: ReadMeABook
description: ReadMeABook is a request and download platform for audiobooks - the audiobook counterpart to Sonarr and Radarr. Users request titles, ReadMeABook finds and fetches them, and the result drops into a library that Audiobookshelf or a similar player can serve.

title: Borg-UI
description: Borg-UI is a web frontend for BorgBackup. It replaces the borg command line for everyday work: creating and browsing repositories, scheduling backups, inspecting archives and restoring files, all from the browser. Borg 1 and Borg 2 are installed alongside it, at the versions the upstream release pins.

title: SuggestArr
description: SuggestArr watches what you actually play on Jellyfin, Plex or Emby, looks up similar titles on TMDB, and automatically files requests for them in Jellyseerr or Overseerr. It turns your viewing history into an automatically growing library without manual searching.

title: Shoko Server
description: Shoko Server organizes anime collections. It identifies files by hash against AniDB, pulls in metadata from TvDB, TMDB and Trakt, and tracks watched state and series relations. Plugins expose the result to Plex, Jellyfin and Kodi, so the library stays correct even with inconsistently named files.

title: Lingarr
description: Lingarr translates subtitles in your Radarr and Sonarr libraries. It watches for media without subtitles in the languages you want and translates existing ones automatically, using either a self-hosted LibreTranslate instance or a hosted provider such as DeepL, OpenAI, Anthropic or Gemini.

title: Elasticsearch
description: Elasticsearch is a distributed search and analytics engine. It is mostly deployed as the backend for something else - log aggregation, full-text search in an application, or as the storage layer for Graylog and similar tools. This installs a single node from the official Elastic repository.

title: llama.cpp
description: llama.cpp runs GGUF language models directly in C/C++ with no Python runtime. Its llama-server offers a built-in web chat and an OpenAI-compatible API, so it can back tools like AnythingLLM, Open WebUI or Claude Code.

title: Proxmox Datacenter Manager Post Install
description: This script performs post-installation routines on a Proxmox Datacenter Manager host: it corrects the Debian sources, manages the pdm-enterprise, pdm-no-subscription and pdm-test repositories, optionally removes the subscription nag, and runs a distribution upgrade. Each step is a separate prompt, so nothing is changed without being asked.

title: AnythingLLM
description: AnythingLLM is an all-in-one AI application: turn documents, websites and other content into a chat-ready knowledge base with RAG, agents and multi-user workspaces. It connects to local model runners such as Ollama and LM Studio as well as OpenAI, Anthropic and other hosted providers.

title: PVE-UPS
description: PVE-UPS is a web-based UPS shutdown appliance for Proxmox VE. It monitors UPS devices via SNMP (RFC 1628 or vendor MIB) or NUT and automatically shuts down Proxmox hosts during power outages, replacing vendor-locked solutions like APC PowerChute.

title: Fedora
description: Fedora is the upstream of Red Hat Enterprise Linux and ships current kernels, compilers and desktop software roughly every six months. This creates a VM from the official Cloud Base image, so the release is picked up from the mirror rather than pinned in the script.

title: Alpine
description: Alpine Linux is a minimal distribution built on musl and BusyBox that idles in well under 100 MB. This creates a VM from the official UEFI cloud image, which gives Alpine a kernel of its own -- the one thing an Alpine LXC cannot have.

title: ZimaOS
description: ZimaOS is the successor to CasaOS: a NAS operating system with an app store, ZFS-backed storage, RAID support and A/B system updates. It targets the Zima hardware line but runs on any x86-64 machine with UEFI.

title: CachyOS
description: CachyOS is a performance-focused Arch derivative with custom kernels, BORE and sched-ext schedulers, and packages built for x86-64-v3/v4. Installation is completed in the graphical Calamares installer.

title: BlissOS
description: BlissOS is Android x86 as a full desktop operating system, running on its own kernel rather than inside a host. It suits a VM with a passed-through GPU, where Android apps get real graphics acceleration and their own machine.

title: Gotenberg
description: Gotenberg is a developer-friendly API for converting numerous document formats (HTML, Markdown, URLs and LibreOffice-supported office documents such as DOCX, XLSX, PPTX and ODF) into PDF. It also merges, splits, flattens and manipulates PDFs using Chromium, LibreOffice, QPDF, pdfcpu, PDFtk and ExifTool. This script builds Gotenberg from source and runs it bare-metal instead of via Docker.

title: Valhalla
description: Valhalla is an open-source routing engine and accompanying libraries for use with OpenStreetMap data. It provides turn-by-turn routing, map matching (snapping noisy GPS traces to the road/path network), time+distance matrices, isochrones and elevation lookups over a self-built tile graph. Commonly run as a self-hosted routing backend so that location data never has to be sent to a third party.

title: Dockhand
description: Dockhand is a modern, efficient Docker management application providing real-time container management, Compose stack orchestration, and multi-environment support. All in a lightweight, secure and privacy-focused package.

title: OpenList
description: OpenList is a file list program that mounts many storage backends - S3, WebDAV, OneDrive, Google Drive, SFTP, local disks and more - behind one web UI, and serves them again over WebDAV, FTP and S3. It is the community-driven fork of AList.

title: NextDNS
description: NextDNS is a DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH) client and resolver that blocks ads, trackers and malware using cloud-managed profiles. It serves DNS for your network on port 53; profiles are managed at my.nextdns.io, there is no local web interface.

title: WRP
description: WRP (Web Rendering Proxy) is a browser-in-browser proxy server that lets historical and vintage web browsers use the modern web. It drives a headless Chromium instance and renders pages back as clickable images or simplified HTML, so clients as old as Mosaic can browse today's HTTPS-only web.

title: T3 Code
description: T3 Code is a web and desktop control surface for running coding agents on your machine.

title: Razzia
description: Razzia is a self-hosted, open-source quiz platform for smaller events. A manager hosts a live quiz from the browser while participants join with a room code from their own devices, with quizzes, results and custom branding stored as files in the config folder.

title: DietPi
description: DietPi is a lightweight Debian-based OS with a curated software catalogue (dietpi-software) and simple configuration tools. The script creates a Debian LXC and converts it with the official dietpi-installer.

title: OpenViking
description: OpenViking is a self-evolving context database for AI agents that unifies agent memory, knowledge RAG and skills. Run it as a standalone HTTP server and connect any client (Python SDK, CLI, or the bundled Web Studio).

title: LocalAI
description: LocalAI is a drop-in replacement for the OpenAI API that runs entirely on your own hardware. One binary serves text generation, image generation, speech-to-text and text-to-speech behind OpenAI-compatible endpoints, backed by a model gallery and pluggable inference backends. Heavier than llama.cpp, but multi-modal and self-managing.

title: LibreDB Studio
description: LibreDB Studio is a browser-based SQL IDE you run on your own server. It connects to PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, SQL Server, MongoDB, Redis, ClickHouse, Elasticsearch and many more databases, with optional AI query help from a local Ollama model.

title: Silo
description: Silo is an S3-compatible object storage server, a community-maintained fork of the open-source MinIO server by PGSTY. It carries on the AGPL release line after upstream MinIO stopped community distribution, with security fixes and the full web console restored. It keeps the MinIO storage format, MINIO_* variables and S3 API, so existing MinIO data and clients keep working.

title: Deemix
description: Deemix is a Deezer music downloader with a web interface, in the maintained community fork by bambanah. It downloads tracks, albums, playlists and discographies from Deezer with tags and cover art, in MP3 or FLAC depending on the account.

title: Folding@home
description: Folding@home is a distributed computing project that simulates protein dynamics to help research diseases such as cancer, Alzheimer's and infectious diseases. This script installs the official v8.5 client, which runs headless and folds work units on the container's CPUs and on any passed-through GPU, managed remotely through the Folding@home Web Control.

title: HedgeDoc
description: HedgeDoc (formerly CodiMD) is a self-hosted, real-time collaborative Markdown editor. Several people can write the same note at once in the browser, with support for diagrams, math, slide presentations and per-note sharing permissions.

title: Listenarr
description: Listenarr automates audiobook collection management in the style of Sonarr and Radarr. It searches torrent and NZB indexers, hands grabs to your download client, and imports and organizes the finished audiobooks with metadata from Audible and other sources.

title: PriceBuddy
description: PriceBuddy is a self-hosted price tracker. Paste a product URL from almost any store and it checks price and stock on a schedule, keeps the price history, compares the same product across retailers, and notifies you by email, Pushover, Gotify, ntfy, Telegram, Discord or Apprise when a deal moves in your favour.

title: ProxCenter
description: ProxCenter is a web console for running several Proxmox VE clusters and Proxmox Backup Server instances from one place, with inventory, in-browser consoles, backup visibility, migrations from VMware and other hypervisors, RBAC and SSO. This is the open-source Community Edition.

title: Youtarr
description: Youtarr is a self-hosted YouTube downloader that subscribes to channels and playlists and downloads new videos on a schedule with yt-dlp. It adds NFO files, posters and metadata so the videos show up cleanly in Plex, Jellyfin, Emby or Kodi.

title: Gitea Runner
description: Gitea Runner (act_runner) is the daemon that executes CI/CD jobs for Gitea Actions. It connects to your Gitea instance, polls for queued workflow runs, and executes tasks using either host execution or containerized engines.

title: Tvheadend
description: Tvheadend is a TV streaming server and Digital Video Recorder for Linux, supporting DVB-S/S2, DVB-C, DVB-T/T2, ATSC, IPTV, SAT>IP and HDHomeRun as input sources, with HTSP and HTTP streaming output.

title: Keeper
description: Keeper is an open-source calendar syncing tool. It pulls events from iCal/ICS links, CalDAV, iCloud, Fastmail, Google Calendar and Outlook, and pushes them to one or many destination calendars, removing copies again when the source event is deleted. Self-hosted instances get every Pro feature.

title: Weblate
description: Weblate is a web-based continuous localization system with tight version control integration. Translators work in the browser while Weblate pulls from and pushes to your Git or Mercurial repositories, with quality checks, translation memory, machine translation, glossaries and add-ons across dozens of file formats.

title: PigeonPod
description: PigeonPod turns YouTube and Bilibili channels and playlists into podcast RSS feeds you can subscribe to in any podcast app. It downloads new episodes as audio or video with yt-dlp, and supports per-feed keyword and duration filters, cookies for restricted content, proxies, and local or S3 storage.

title: Firefox Syncserver
description: Firefox Syncserver (syncstorage-rs) is Mozilla's server behind Firefox Sync. It keeps your bookmarks, history, passwords, tabs and add-ons on your own hardware, encrypted by Firefox before upload, while you still sign in with a regular Mozilla account.

title: Streamystats
description: Streamystats is a statistics and analytics service for Jellyfin. It shows watch history, per-user, library and client statistics and watch-time graphs for one or more servers, and can import history from Jellystat and the Playback Reporting plugin.

title: CertMate
description: CertMate is a self-hosted SSL/TLS certificate manager. It issues and renews certificates over ACME (Let's Encrypt, ZeroSSL or a private ACME CA) with DNS-01 across many DNS providers or HTTP-01, renews them on a schedule, and exposes a web UI and a REST API for issuing, downloading and deploying certificates, with encrypted backups and webhook notifications.

title: ByteChef
description: ByteChef is an open-source API integration and workflow automation platform. Workflows are built visually from 170+ connectors, conditions, loops and JavaScript, Python or Ruby code steps, and run manually, on a schedule or from webhooks.

title: Dragonfly
description: Dragonfly is an in-memory data store compatible with the Redis and Memcached APIs, so existing Redis clients and tools work against it unchanged. It is multi-threaded, uses every core it is given and takes snapshots without forking.

title: Mathesar
description: Mathesar is a spreadsheet-like web interface for PostgreSQL. Users of any technical skill level can view, edit, query and collaborate on Postgres data directly, build relationships between tables, import CSV files and create forms, while access is governed by native PostgreSQL roles and privileges.

title: FalkorDB
description: FalkorDB is a low-latency property graph database built on sparse matrices (GraphBLAS), aimed at knowledge graphs and GraphRAG. It runs as a Redis module queried with OpenCypher from any Redis client, and FalkorDB Browser adds a web UI for queries and exploring graphs.

title: Windmill
description: Windmill is an open-source developer platform that turns scripts into webhooks, workflows and UIs. Scripts in Python, TypeScript, Bash, SQL and more get an auto-generated form and API, and can be chained into flows, run on schedules or triggers, and back low-code apps.

title: Vane
description: Vane (formerly Perplexica) is a self-hosted AI answering engine in the style of Perplexity. It searches the web through SearXNG and answers with cited sources, using a local LLM through Ollama or a cloud provider such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini or Groq.

title: HomeTube
description: HomeTube is a web UI for yt-dlp that downloads single videos or whole playlists into a clean folder structure for Plex, Jellyfin or Emby. It embeds subtitles, chapters and metadata, skips sponsor segments with SponsorBlock and keeps playlists in sync.

title: WatchState
description: WatchState syncs play state (watched/unwatched and resume progress) between Plex, Jellyfin and Emby without relying on third-party services. It pulls changes from the media servers through scheduled imports or webhooks and pushes them to the others one-way or two-way, maps the users of each server, keeps portable backups of the play state and audits mismatched records with Media Health. This script builds the PHP backend and the web UI from source and serves them with nginx, PHP-FPM and Redis.

title: 8mb.local
description: 8mb.local is a self-hosted video compressor inspired by 8mb.video, free for non-commercial use (CC BY-NC 4.0). Pick a target size such as 8, 25 or 50 MB and it works out the bitrate and encodes to H.264, HEVC or AV1, on the CPU or with NVENC, Quick Sync or VAAPI.

title: Databasement
description: Databasement is a self-hosted backup manager for MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, SQLite and Redis/Valkey. It runs scheduled or on-demand backups, optionally through an SSH tunnel, stores them locally or on S3, SFTP, FTP, Samba or Azure, and restores them to any registered server.

title: TaskView
description: TaskView is a source-available project and task management platform for teams. It offers task lists, Kanban boards, sprints and time tracking, plus organizations with role-based permissions, SSO, webhooks and issue sync with GitHub, GitLab and Gitea.

title: Cinephage
description: Cinephage is a self-hosted media manager that covers in one app what usually takes Radarr, Sonarr, Prowlarr, Bazarr and Overseerr: it discovers, searches, downloads and organizes movies and TV shows, manages indexers and subtitles, and adds smart lists, .strm streaming and Live TV. Cloudflare-protected indexers are handled by a built-in headless browser (Camoufox) instead of FlareSolverr. Downloads go to external clients such as qBittorrent, SABnzbd or NZBGet.

title: Note Mark
description: Note Mark is a fast, minimal web-based Markdown note-taking app. Notes are kept as plain Markdown files on disk and can be shared with other users or publicly, with a CodeMirror editor, optional Vim keybindings and optional OpenID Connect login.

title: Figranium
description: Figranium is a self-hosted browser automation platform. You build workflows from blocks such as navigate, click, type and extract in a visual editor, run them in headless Chromium, and trigger them from the UI, on a schedule or through the REST API.

title: Ideon
description: Ideon is a self-hosted visual workspace that maps a project on an infinite canvas. Notes, files, links, tasks, kanban boards, sketches and live Git repository blocks sit side by side, are edited together in real time and can be rewound to earlier snapshots.

title: Reconya
description: Reconya is a network reconnaissance and asset discovery tool. It sweeps your networks with ICMP, ARP and TCP probes, identifies devices and their open ports, and alerts on new devices or risky ports, all in a web console with a topology map.

title: Soulbeet
description: Soulbeet is a self-hosted music downloader and library manager. It finds albums and tracks on Soulseek through slskd, tags and files them into your library with beets, and can push discovery playlists from your Last.fm or ListenBrainz history to Navidrome.

title: Meme Search
description: Meme Search is a self-hosted search engine for your own meme collection. A local vision model writes a description of each image, and the memes can then be found by keyword or by meaning, tagged, and fetched through a read-only search API.

title: Casdoor
description: Casdoor is an open-source identity and access management (IAM) and single sign-on platform. It acts as an OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML and CAS provider with LDAP, RADIUS and SCIM endpoints, social logins, MFA and WebAuthn, and Casbin-based permissions.

title: Gopeed
description: Gopeed is a fast download manager for HTTP(S), BitTorrent, Magnet links and ed2k, written in Go and Flutter. It supports JavaScript extensions, a REST API, webhooks, post-download scripts and browser integration.

title: Hanko
description: Hanko is an open-source authentication and user management backend, an alternative to Auth0 or Clerk. It provides passkeys, passwords, email passcodes, MFA and single sign-on, and web apps add the login through the Hanko Elements web components or SDKs.

title: Typecho
description: Typecho is a lightweight, open-source PHP blogging platform with a Markdown editor, pages, categories and tags, threaded comments, themes, plugins and an XML-RPC API for desktop and mobile editors.

title: ChartDB
description: ChartDB is a database diagram editor that runs in the browser. One query against PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server, SQLite, ClickHouse or CockroachDB returns the schema, which ChartDB turns into an editable ER diagram that can be exported as SQL, DBML or an image.

title: Blinko
description: Blinko is a self-hosted, open-source AI note-taking tool. Short "blinkos" capture quick ideas and longer notes hold the rest, all in Markdown with tags and todos. With an AI provider such as OpenAI, Anthropic or Ollama it adds RAG search and a chat over your notes.

title: Nightingale
description: Nightingale is an open-source monitoring and alerting platform. It queries data sources such as Prometheus, VictoriaMetrics, Elasticsearch or Loki, and adds alert rules, muting, notifications to more than 20 channels, dashboards and a built-in time series database.

title: UniFi Protect Backup
description: Backs up UniFi Protect motion and smart-detection event clips to local or rclone-supported off-site storage in real time.

title: Stump
description: Stump is a free and open-source comics, manga and digital book server. It organizes CBZ, CBR, EPUB and PDF files into libraries and series, reads them in the browser with progress tracking, and serves them to OPDS readers and the Stump mobile apps.

title: Woodpecker CI
description: Woodpecker CI is a simple, community-driven CI/CD engine for Forgejo, Gitea, GitHub, GitLab and Bitbucket. Pipelines are YAML files in the repository that run on pushes, pull requests, tags or schedules, with matrix builds, secrets and a web UI with live logs.

title: VictoriaLogs
description: VictoriaLogs is a fast, cost-effective and scalable open-source log database that can efficiently handle terabytes of logs with minimal resources.

title: Norish
description: Norish is a realtime, self-hosted recipe app for families and friends. Recipes are imported from a link, pasted text or photos, organised in cookbooks, planned on a calendar and turned into a shared grocery list that updates live for everyone in the household.

title: Kyoo
description: Kyoo is a self-hosted media server for movies, series and anime, an alternative to Jellyfin or Plex. It identifies files without a required folder structure, pulls metadata from TheMovieDB and TheTVDB, and transcodes on the fly with hardware acceleration.

title: Activepieces
description: Activepieces is an open-source workflow automation platform and Zapier alternative. Flows are built visually from hundreds of integrations, branches, loops, approvals and TypeScript code steps, run on schedules, webhooks or app events, and every integration is also available as an MCP tool.

title: useSend
description: useSend is an open-source email sending platform and self-hosted alternative to Resend, SendGrid or Postmark. It sends transactional email through a REST API, SDKs or SMTP and marketing campaigns from a visual editor, with tracking, bounce handling and webhooks, delivered through Amazon SES.

title: Budibase
description: Budibase is a low-code platform for building internal tools such as forms, portals, admin panels and approval apps. Apps run on its built-in database or on PostgreSQL, MySQL, REST APIs and Google Sheets, with automations triggered by events, schedules or webhooks.

title: Rauthy
description: Rauthy is a single sign-on identity and access management server. It is an OpenID Connect and OAuth 2 provider with an admin UI, passkey (FIDO2/WebAuthn) and OTP multi-factor login, upstream login providers, SCIM, forward auth and PAM/SSH login.

title: Formbricks
description: Formbricks is an open-source survey and experience management platform and an alternative to Qualtrics. It runs link, website and in-app surveys with logic and multiple languages, and passes responses on through webhooks, the API and integrations such as Slack, Notion and Zapier.

title: Ryot
description: Ryot (Roll Your Own Tracker) is a self-hosted tracker for the media you consume and the workouts you do. It logs movies, shows, books, games, anime, podcasts and more with metadata from TMDB, IGDB, OpenLibrary and AniList, and records workouts and body measurements.

title: Unifi OS Server  VM
description: Unifi OS Server VM is the operating system that powers Ubiquiti's UniFi line of network devices. It provides a centralized platform for managing and monitoring UniFi access points, switches, and security gateways, offering features such as network configuration, device provisioning, and performance analytics.

title: openGym
description: openGym is a self-hosted gym and body-weight tracker. Plan weekly routines, log workouts with supersets and cardio, track body weight, measurements and personal records, and browse a library of more than 5,600 exercises with animations. Every profile keeps its own data and syncs across devices; the web app installs to the home screen, and an Android app can pair with your server. This script builds the web app from source and runs the Node.js API behind nginx.

title: Downtify
description: Downtify is a self-hosted music downloader with a web interface. Paste a Spotify, YouTube Music or Deezer link, or search by name, and it reads the metadata without a Spotify account or API key, downloads the matching audio from YouTube Music with yt-dlp and tags it with cover art and lyrics. It also has a library with a built-in player, a Playlist Monitor that downloads new tracks from watched playlists and artists, podcasts, M3U export for Jellyfin, Navidrome and Plex, and accounts for several users.

title: Dreeve
description: Dreeve, formerly Statistics for Strava, is a self-hosted dashboard for sports and fitness data. It imports your Strava activities and turns them into statistics, heatmaps, gear tracking, training analysis and yearly overviews.

title: AIOStreams
description: AIOStreams consolidates multiple Stremio addons and debrid services into a single, highly customisable super-addon, with filtering, sorting, and formatting of results.

title: Anubis
description: Anubis is a reverse proxy that sits in front of a web service and stops AI scrapers and abusive bots with a proof-of-work challenge, while letting real browsers and well-behaved crawlers through.

title: Calagopus
description: Modern game server management panel built in Rust. Deploy, monitor, and manage Minecraft, Hytale, and other game servers with industry-leading performance.

title: EmDash
description: EmDash is a full-stack TypeScript CMS built on Astro and meant as a modern successor to WordPress. It has a visual schema builder, a media library, revisions and scheduled publishing, sandboxed plugins, WordPress import and an MCP server for AI tools.

title: Honcho
description: Honcho is an open-source memory server for building stateful AI agents. Apps store the messages of users and agents through a REST API or the Python and TypeScript SDKs, and an LLM derives conclusions about each peer that agents can then query in natural language.

title: Netronome
description: Netronome is a network speed test and monitoring tool with a web interface. It runs Speedtest.net, LibreSpeed and iperf3 tests on demand or on a schedule, watches packet loss and DNS, and collects metrics from agents on your servers.

title: tinyMediaManager
description: tinyMediaManager is a media library manager for organizing and scraping metadata, artwork, and NFO files for movies and TV shows, ready for Kodi, Plex, Jellyfin and Emby. Browser access is the desktop UI via noVNC.

title: EspoCRM
description: EspoCRM is an open-source CRM for managing contacts, accounts, leads, opportunities, cases and email, with a customizable entity manager and a REST API.

title: Lidify
description: Lidify is a music discovery tool for Lidarr. It reads your existing Lidarr artists and uses Last.fm, Spotify or MusicBrainz to suggest similar artists, which can then be added straight back into Lidarr from the web UI.

title: YTPTube
description: YTPTube is a self-hosted web interface and download manager for yt-dlp. It queues URLs, playlists, channels and live streams, checks sources on a schedule, and adds reusable presets, notifications, a file browser and a built-in player.

title: JumpServer
description: JumpServer is an open-source PAM (Privileged Access Management) / bastion host that provides unified, audited access to SSH, RDP, VNC, Telnet, Kubernetes and database assets through a single web console, with full session recording and playback.
